The difference depends on the material being processed, as well. For example, it is easier to hear with white noise~, than pink~ noise.
In any case, the shape of the sweep should sound (and look) the same in both of the linear modes (Hz and linear). only the scaling of input values is different.
By default, onepole~ interprets cutoff frequency values as linear Hertz. as a convenience. It also supports an input range of 0. - 1.
